payload.purpose_context: Durable artifacts keep citing bare commit SHAs and line ranges that the mission lifecycle's own rebases and compaction leave dangling, squad briefs declare blockers resolved without reproducing them, the anti-AI-prose rules reach only internal reports, and the common-docs styleguide still teaches the path-string audience and related shapes that doc-kitty rejects. This mission states the stable-identifier and content-anchored citation rules once in the writing pack's citation styleguide, adds reproduce-before-resolved and reachability-before-ruling steps to the squad procedure, ships a shared AI-writing-tells styleguide that internal report writing references, and rewrites the common-docs guidance around doc-kitty's frontmatter with neutral examples.
payload.purpose_tldr: Give writers one citable rule for citations that survive history rewrites, one shared list of AI-prose tells, and doc-kitty frontmatter as the docs default.

options: A principle in writing research-citation-discipline, stated once and cross-referenced with #150

payload.final_answer: A principle in writing research-citation-discipline, stated once and cross-referenced with #150's content-anchored citation rule; not a new directive (operator default accepted 2026-11-21, verified by the dispatcher; source core #2897).

options: A shared styleguide in writing that internal report-writing references

payload.final_answer: A shared styleguide in the writing pack; internal report-writing references it instead of restating the rules (operator default accepted 2026-11-21; tier ruling on #238, 2026-11-12).

options: doc-kitty shape as the consumer default, path form named as legacy only
payload.question: Which frontmatter shape does common-docs teach consumers?

payload.final_answer: doc-kitty's shape is the consumer default: audience as a list of {profile, guidance_text}, related as page slugs, other links under external_references; the path form is mentioned only as legacy (operator ruling on #240, 2026-11-12; default accepted 2026-11-21).
